direct_clause_bindings.hypotheses: Constant m>0 and P=mU only on the massive branch; nonzero future null P and separate positive scale on the null branch; finite lists of future-causal momenta at one tangent space; pointwise collision balance; no transfer between tangent spaces without transport.
